semantic_reason: The issue reports a real failure (QLC cursor filesystem errors when cwd isn't writable, causing silent eviction failure). The PR fixes #329 by stripping out :qlc from the LRW policy and replacing it with Cachex.stream/ETS selects to avoid the tmpdir dependency. Although it also renames Query.create to Query.where (a refactor), the core change addresses the reported defect. The triggering tests exercise query creation and streaming, which are the affected paths.
